root_cause.text: The `ioremap_prot()` implementation on arm64 erroneously preserved user permission bits (such as `PTE_USER`) from the input `pgprot_t` when creating kernel mappings, leading to access violations on systems with Privileged Access Never (PAN) enabled.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that `pgprot_t` "contains all of the non-address bits from the pte, including the permission controls," causing `ioremap_prot()` to return "a new user mapping... which faults when accessed from the kernel." The patch fixes this by masking `user_prot_val & PTE_ATTRINDX_MASK` and applying `PAGE_KERNEL` instead of passing the raw `pgprot_t`.
